note: Store availability and player-card selection policy. FIFA 17 did not publish numerical pack probabilities; these are configurable revival values, not claimed retail odds.

inactiveSpecialTrigger.note: Retained for possible future balancing only. Active specials currently join the weighted rare-player pool directly; pack selection does not read this trigger.

playerVariantPolicy.note: Selects one definition per assetId from the latest base card and all packable specials. Highest rating wins; siteId and resourceId break ties. Future scheduled promo eligibility belongs in this selection stage, before pack weighting.

playerSelectionWeights.note: Applies to the combined selected-special and base-card pool for rare player slots. Higher card power means lower selection weight; pool-kind multipliers are applied afterward.
